description: The 256-colour RGB lookup table the client-side raster renderer painted for each bundled ramp when ramps were stored as js-colormaps float lists: evaluate_cmap(i / 255, name) for i = 0..255, rrggbb per colour. `qualitative` lists the ramps it stepped through a short colour list rather than interpolating. Kept so tests can show the 256-colour RGBA bundle paints the same ramps.
